candidate.name: Runtime
candidate.one_liner: Sandboxed coding agents for everyone on a team

provenance.title: Launch HN: Runtime (YC P26) – Sandboxed coding agents for everyone on a team

facts.statement: Runtime's product is sandboxed coding agents for everyone on a team.
facts.value: Sandboxed coding agents for everyone on a team

facts.statement: Runtime's product enables the whole team, including non-engineers, to ship code with AI coding agents without engineering handholding each session.
Runtime positions itself as an infrastructure that lets teams run and build AI coding agents safely at scale through sandboxed environments with guardrails and observability.
facts.value: sandboxed coding agents infrastructure with guardrails and observability

facts.statement: Runtime works with multiple AI agents including Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, relying on APIs from providers like Anthropic and OpenAI.
facts.value: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini, Devin agents and relevant APIs

facts.statement: The Runtime product and related open-source repositories were active and publicly launched by January 2026 and discussed in May 2026.
The core of Runtime is open source and publicly available at https://github.com/runtm-ai/runtm.
Runtime acts as a control plane and runtime environment orchestrating isolated cloud sandboxed environments where AI coding agents build, test, and deploy software.
facts.value: control plane and sandboxed runtime environment

facts.statement: Runtime stores and accumulates data for every agent run, including prompts, steps, tools used, costs, and results for observability and auditing.
Users can self-serve by signing up for a free tier hosted version at https://app.runtm.com, where no infrastructure needs to be managed.
Runtime's pricing includes a flat platform fee plus compute cost, with no markup on tokens, and a free tier is included on the hosted version.
The Runtime open source repository had 291 stars as of 2026-08-23.
The Runtime open source repository was created on 2026-01-02 and last pushed to on 2026-08-21, indicating ongoing development.
A fintech unicorn and several YC scaleups are live users of Runtime, including teams who previously built similar infrastructure internally.
Runtime integrates with tools and services such as Slack, Linear, GitHub, Stripe, Zendesk, PagerDuty, Sentry, Postgres, NetSuite, and Snowflake.
The runtm-ai GitHub account is an Organization account.
